summary: Land acquisition suit; limitation under Articles 58, 72 Limitation Act; road constructed in 1987; suit filed in 2003; concurrent findings of lower courts on limitation upheld; High Court erred in interfering under Section 100 CPC; no substantial question of law framed; impugned judgment set aside; trial court decree restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashed; trial court decree dismissing suit restored; no costs.
